panels.title: Net P&L today (after costs)
panels.description: What the drawdown breaker acts on. Realised minus costs — not gross, because a gross figure has been wrong every time it was used to judge a day.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "net_pnl_today")
  |> last()

panels.title: Open positions
panels.description: Must be zero outside 09:15-15:10. Anything held past the square-off deadline is a failure of session control, not a trade.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "open_positions")
  |> last()

panels.title: Trades today
panels.description: Read alongside costs. At ~0.12R of friction per round trip, trade count is the main lever on whether costs eat the edge.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "trade_count")
  |> last()

panels.title: Costs today
panels.description: Brokerage, STT, exchange, GST, SEBI and stamp duty. If this approaches net P&L the day was over-traded regardless of how the P&L looks.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "costs_today")
  |> last()

panels.title: Intraday P&L — realised vs net of costs
panels.description: The gap between the two lines IS the cost drag. Plotting only the net figure hides how much of the day's work went to friction.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "realized_pnl_today" or r._field == "net_pnl_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Total open risk (rupees at stop)
panels.description: The primary risk control (§2.1). This is the sum of distance-to-stop across open positions — the number the 1.5% cap bounds. Counting positions bounds nothing, which is why this is the panel that matters.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total_open_risk")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Gross exposure
panels.description: Notional across open positions. Bounded separately from risk because MIS leverage means a small risk figure can still carry a large position.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position_updates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gross_exposure")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Fill prices by instrument
panels.description: Every genuine fill. Acceptance is not execution (defect B3), so this plots average_fill_price and nothing else.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "filled_orders")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "average_fill_price")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> group(columns: ["instrument_id"])
